comment: Every tracked test file belongs to exactly one suite, and every suite names the required checks that run it (ADR-1528). scripts/ci/suite_registry.py check enforces both; scripts/ci/suite_registry.py run tooling runs the tooling suite. docs/development/test-suites.md describes each suite.

suites.name: core
suites.runs: Meson tests registered in core/test/meson.build and core/tools/test/meson.build; backend-gated tests run in the all-backend Linux Intel LLVM leg

suites.name: python-harness
suites.runs: pytest python/test/ (Coverage Gate) and tox -c python (Ubuntu gcc, on C-core changes)

suites.name: go
suites.runs: go test ./... against the CPU + ONNX Runtime libvmaf build

suites.name: rust
suites.runs: cargo test --workspace --all-features against the installed CPU libvmaf

suites.name: tooling
suites.runs: scripts/ci/suite_registry.py run tooling: one pytest run over every Python test file, then every shell test file with bash

not_tests.reason: dataset definition modules named after their dataset (test_*.py); the Coverage Gate ignores the directory
the Meson test runner wrapper (ADR-1333), not a test
local driver that runs make ci inside every docker/dev image; it builds containers and is not a test
benchmark driver that needs oneAPI, an installed vmaf and GPU devices; it prints scores and asserts nothing
